text: {"name":"company_invitations","description":"An invitation for a recipient address to join a company with one grant; only the person signed in with that verified address can accept it.","owner":"Organizations","classification":"CONFIDENTIAL","lifecycle":"Created PENDING with a seven-day validity; becomes ACCEPTED, REVOKED by an inviter, REPLACED by a resend or EXPIRED. precision"},{"Column":"invited_by_membership_id","PostgreSQL type":"uuid","Nullable":"no","Default":"—","Classification":"INTERNAL","Meaning":"Membership of the inviter, whose authority is rechecked
